artifact.description: SCRAM fault-tree engine 0.16.2, built from source inside WSL2 Ubuntu with a pinned conda-forge toolchain. Used by SNEED as a separate process; never bundled.

license.evidence: LICENSE in the source tree is the GNU GPL v3 text; all 66 source files carry the 'version 3 ... or (at your option) any later version' header (checked 2026-10-05)
license.source_obligations: SCRAM is only started as a separate process and is built on the user's machine from the pinned commit; the recipe and commit identify the corresponding source. If a built binary is ever shipped or cached for other people, the corresponding source and this recipe must accompany it. That case has not been reviewed by anyone qualified.

trust.source_identity: git commit id (content addressed); the checkout is verified against it
trust.authenticity: not established: hashes prove content identity only. The trust anchors are this reviewed recipe, the pinned commit and the conda-forge URLs in the lock; whoever publishes the recipe vouches for them.

prerequisites.label: WSL2 with a Linux distribution
prerequisites.fix: Install WSL: open a terminal as administrator and run `wsl --install`. This is a system change and is done by the user.

prerequisites.label: conda (Miniconda or Miniforge) inside the distribution
prerequisites.fix: Install Miniconda or Miniforge inside the WSL distribution.

prerequisites.label: git inside the distribution
prerequisites.fix: Install git inside the WSL distribution (apt install git).

prerequisites.label: network access to github.com and conda.anaconda.org
prerequisites.fix: The install downloads about 200 MB. Offline installation needs a cache that this recipe does not provide yet.
